create.title: New service
create.description: A service is what you offer (a consultation, a haircut, a file drop-off). You then add its opening hours and resources.
create.name: Service name
create.failed: The service could not be created.

entranceQr.title: Entrance QR for today's line
entranceQr.text: Show this QR at your entrance: walk-in clients scan it, take a ticket and follow their place on their phone. They're told when it's their turn.

list.title: Services
list.emptyText: Create a service to open its line for the day and share its booking link.

rowActions.title: Actions
rowActions.renameDescription: The service name appears on the booking link and on the day's line.
rowActions.name: Name
rowActions.deleteDescription: The service, its slots, its tickets and its counter links will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone.

manage.notFound: This service doesn't exist or isn't yours.
manage.open: Open the link in a new tab

bookingLink.title: Public booking link
bookingLink.text: Share this link (WhatsApp, bio, message): anyone who has it can pick a time without an account.

staff.title: Counter staff
staff.text: Each link opens the console on a phone. When someone leaves, revoke their link and their access stops at once.
staff.name: Station name

resources.title: Resources
resources.text: The people, places and equipment a slot needs. A deactivated resource stops being offered without disturbing existing bookings.
resources.name: Name

requirements.title: Service requirements
requirements.text: What a slot uses: a slot is offered only when every requirement is met (e.g. 1 person + 1 place for a colouring).
requirements.empty: No requirements: add at least one to open slots.

schedule.weeklyEmpty: No hours: the resource is never offered.

reminders.title: Appointment reminders
reminders.text: Send your clients a reminder before their appointment to cut no-shows.
reminders.offsetsText: A reminder goes out at each chosen time before the appointment starts.

errors.loadConfig: The service settings couldn't be loaded.
errors.bookingLink: The booking link couldn't be created.
errors.staffLoad: The counter links couldn't be loaded.
errors.staffCreate: The counter link couldn't be created.
